title: Monocytic differentiation and AHR signaling as primary nodes of BET inhibitor response in acute myeloid leukemia
model: OCI-AML2 parental and JQ1-resistant cells, Yusa genome-wide knockout library, JQ1
contrast: JQ1 vs DMSO day 14: parental (2 vs 2) and JQ1-resistant (2 vs 3)
paper_calls: SPI1, JUNB, FOS, AHR/ARNT as response determinants; BCL2 and CDK6 as vulnerabilities in resistant cells
barcs_calls: Parental: 1 gene at FDR 0.10; resistant: 2,750 genes (no controls to calibrate, likely inflated)
named_hits: BCL2 called (FDR 0.009); FOS #5 and SPI1 #75 enriched but not called; JUNB, AHR, ARNT, CDK6 not supported
verdict: BARCS supports BCL2 as a vulnerability of JQ1-resistant cells and ranks FOS and SPI1 high for resistance, but JUNB, AHR, ARNT and CDK6 are not supported, and without controls the resistant-line call list is inflated.
